issue: IP Spoofing & Security Bypass via Untrusted Proxy Headers
recommendation: Restrict `extract_ip` to only trust `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Real-IP` if the connection originates from a trusted local proxy address (e.g., `127.0.0.1` or defined subnet). Otherwise, strictly use the socket connection peer IP.

issue: Complete Lack of Access Control Enforcement on Resolved AccessZone
recommendation: Implement an authorization guard middleware or interceptor that checks the attached `AccessZone` against the required security level of the target endpoint and rejects unauthorized requests before they reach the handlers.
Remove all hardcoded API keys from the source code. Load authorized bypass tokens dynamically from a secure environment variable or vault at runtime, and rotate them regularly.

issue: Unencrypted Plaintext Storage of WireGuard Private Keys
recommendation: Implement AES-GCM encryption using a key derived from a secure master secret (not stored in the user database) before writing the WireGuard private key to `wg_private_key_encrypted` in `privacy-users.json`.

issue: Ad-Hoc JSON Contracts Violating Schema-As-Code Discipline
recommendation: Refactor all JSON-RPC and contract interactions (e.g. Incus states, OpenFlow configurations) to use versioned Protocol Buffer definitions (`.proto`) and autogenerated Rust structs instead of raw `simd_json::OwnedValue` mappings.

issue: Absence of OSCAL System Security Plan & Automated Control Audits
recommendation: Document the network control plane boundaries and access rules in a machine-readable OSCAL System Security Plan (SSP) and generate OSCAL Component Definitions to validate compliance during host-level provisioning.

issue: Sensitive Magic Link Authentication Token Leakage to Console/Stdout
recommendation: Disable stdout/console logging of the verification link and tokens in production. Restrict local logging of authentication secrets to local test/debug profiles using conditional compilation (`#[cfg(debug_assertions)]`).
